sources.title: Chipotle announces third quarter 2026 results (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99.1)

scenes.title: Your $10 at Chipotle
scenes.sub: Where every dollar goes, using Chipotle's own costs
scenes.sub_html: Where every dollar goes, using Chipotle's own costs

lines.say: You spend ten dollars at Chipotle. Here's where it goes.
lines.show: You spend $10 at Chipotle. Here's where it goes.

lines.say: These are Chipotle's real costs from its latest earnings report.
lines.show: These are Chipotle's real costs from its latest earnings report.

lines.say: About two ninety five goes to food and packaging. The chicken, the rice, the bowl.
lines.show: About $2.95 goes to food and packaging. The chicken, the rice, the bowl.

lines.say: About two fifty seven pays the people making your order.
lines.show: About $2.57 pays the people making your order.

lines.say: About two fourteen covers restaurant rent and other store costs.
lines.show: About $2.14 covers restaurant rent and other store costs.

lines.say: That leaves about two thirty three at the restaurant level.
lines.show: That leaves about $2.33 at the restaurant level.

scenes.label: of every $10
scenes.note: After corporate costs and new stores

lines.say: After corporate costs and opening new stores, Chipotle keeps about one thirty seven.
lines.show: After corporate costs and opening new stores, Chipotle keeps about $1.37.

lines.say: Small slices, but on three point three billion dollars in sales in three months.
lines.show: Small slices, but on $3.3 billion in sales in three months.

scenes.takeaway: Small margins times huge volume equals big profit.
scenes.source: Data: Chipotle Q3 2026 results, SEC filing
